reference_sql:
WITH order_values AS (  -- one row per order of a registered customer in January to June 2025
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS order_value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts
),
running AS (  -- one row per order, with the customer's spend up to and including it
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts, order_value_eur,
         SUM(order_value_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id
                                    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_to_date_eur
  FROM order_values
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS gold_date, spend_to_date_eur
FROM running
WHERE spend_to_date_eur >= 4000
  AND spend_to_date_eur - order_value_eur < 4000
ORDER BY customer_id

WITH order_values AS (  -- one row per order of a registered customer in January to June 2025
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS order_value_eur
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN sales AS s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts
),
running AS (  -- one row per order, with the running spend after it and before it
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts,
         SUM(order_value_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts ASC, order_id ASC
                                    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_to_date_eur,
         COALESCE(SUM(order_value_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts ASC, order_id ASC
                                             ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS spend_before_eur
  FROM order_values
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS gold_date, spend_to_date_eur
FROM running
WHERE spend_before_eur < 4000 AND spend_to_date_eur >= 4000
ORDER BY 1

WITH order_values AS (  -- one row per order of a registered customer in January to June 2025
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS order_value_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < '2025-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts
),
running AS (  -- one row per order: the customer's orders up to and including it, by order_ts and then order_id, added up
  SELECT a.customer_id, a.order_id, a.order_ts, a.order_value_eur, SUM(b.order_value_eur) AS spend_to_date_eur
  FROM order_values a
  JOIN order_values b
    ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id
   AND (b.order_ts < a.order_ts OR (b.order_ts = a.order_ts AND b.order_id <= a.order_id))
  GROUP BY a.customer_id, a.order_id, a.order_ts, a.order_value_eur
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS gold_date, spend_to_date_eur
FROM running
WHERE spend_to_date_eur >= 4000 AND spend_to_date_eur - order_value_eur < 4000
ORDER BY customer_id ASC

WITH ov AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS order_value
  FROM orders o
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts
),
run AS (
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts,
         SUM(order_value) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_to_date_eur
  FROM ov
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS gold_date, spend_to_date_eur
FROM run
WHERE spend_to_date_eur >= 4000
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id) = 1
ORDER BY customer_id ASC
